caption: The drawing shows a simple line illustration of a wooden chair from three different perspectives: front view (left), top view (center), and side view (right). The chair has a ladder-style back with three curved horizontal slats and two vertical posts with finial tops. The seat is square and appears to be woven, indicated by closely spaced lines in the top view. Four legs are depicted, the front ones straight and the back ones extending upward to form the backrest posts. Two sets of horizontal stretchers connect the legs for added support, with the lower stretchers being straight and the upper ones positioned just below the seat. The drawing uses fine black lines on an off-white background. At the bottom right corner, there is a scale notation: "Scale 2 1/2" = 1' ". The overall composition arranges the views in a row, with the top view above the front and side views.
title: Chair
